name: ReaperMCP
description: Reviews destructive REAPER project-editing tools: batch track deletion, track template deletion, clearing every tempo marker, and multi-step undo. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep track_delete_batch, track_template_delete, and tempo_clear_all on Review unless this device needs unattended batch deletes.
project_undo accepts steps=1-100 and can undo REAPER history entries ReaperMCP did not create, so it stays on Review; single-step undo remains available after approval.
